title: PackageDocument v3
description: Unified package-level output for uasset_read v3 (intentional breaking rewrite of the v2 envelope). One document per .uasset/.umap file, expressing all exports as first-class objects plus embedded projection records and optional physical sidecars.

format_version.description: Schema version. Envelope field injected by projection.py (FORMAT_VERSION); not carried on PackageDocument.

depth.description: Determines parsing cost and detail level.

relations.description: Object-to-object relationships. Omitted only when the requester opted the section out via projection `sections` (#631).

dependencies.description: Package-level import dependencies. Omitted only when the requester opted the section out via projection `sections` (#631).

projections.description: Type-aware projections embedded in the canonical document (Blueprint declaration/migration, material graph, table data, metadata references). Every record carries explicit capability/status; every embedded record also carries provenance (schema-enforced). Unavailable information is never replaced with fabricated source.

sidecars.description: Physical sidecar files created only when a payload or size boundary makes a single physical file unsafe. Each entry records relative path, size, SHA-256, reason, and the serialized source range.

byte_accounting.description: Complete per-object byte-accounting scopes. An object cannot be declared complete merely because its convenience property map is non-empty: every requested non-empty export window is exactly tiled by its non-empty leaf regions.

next_offset.description: Continuation cursor when objects were truncated. Valid only for bounded/paginated responses; the canonical writer omits it.

truncation.description: Truncation metadata emitted when limit or max_bytes cut the page. Valid only for bounded responses; the canonical writer omits it.

debug.description: Extra parse statistics for the debug view.

path.description: Relative or absolute path (omitted in agent output for security).

ObjectEntry.description: id/name are the only keys that survive a projection `fields` trim; untrimmed projections carry roles/status too. The richer identity fields (class_ref/outer_ref/super_ref/template_ref, per-object diagnostics, serial source ranges, ordered properties) are part of the canonical v3 envelope as they land.

id.description: Stable id: table type + zero-based index.

class.description: Resolved class name (null when unresolvable, e.g. imports with missing outer).

class_ref.description: Class reference as a table/index pair; null when unresolvable.

outer_ref.description: Outer (containing object) reference; null for top-level objects.

super_ref.description: Superclass reference; null when the object has none.

roles.description: 叠加标签，不是互斥类型。

serial_region.description: Serialized source range of this object in the package.

properties.description: Property bag: either the name-keyed normalized map (raw/debug views, depth >= object) or the canonical ordered occurrence list with array-index and value ranges.

semantic.description: Domain-specific extension (only when depth >= asset and handler supports this object).

ObjectRef.description: Reference to another package object as a table/index pair, or null.

PropertyEntry.description: One ordered property occurrence. Duplicate names and array elements stay distinct; lookup by name is a derived convenience view.

type.description: Property type name from the tag (e.g. StrProperty); omitted when unknown.

occurrence.description: 0-based occurrence of this name on the object; repeated names keep their serialized order.

array_index.description: Array element index when the property tag carries one; null for non-array values.

tag_range.description: Serialized range of the property tag.

value_range.description: Serialized range of the property value.

value.description: JSON-safe projected value or opaque descriptor (never inline raw bytes).

ProjectionRecord.description: One type-aware projection derived from the same PackageDocument. Exactly one of: embedded content (embedded=true + content + provenance, no external) or an external sidecar reference (embedded=false + external, no content). The four statuses are the migration-mode contract: translated, represented, untranslated, unavailable.

source_object_id.description: Object the projection was derived from.

kind.description: Projection kind (e.g. blueprint_declaration, blueprint_migration, material_graph, material_builder, table_data, metadata_reference).

media_type.description: Media type of the projected content (e.g. text/x-c++, application/json, text/csv).

embedded.description: True when content is embedded in this document; false when the payload lives in an external sidecar.

status.description: translated = mapped to a known construct; represented = preserved as call/reference or migration hook; untranslated = source information exists but no safe mapping is known; unavailable = source bytes or editor data are absent.

completeness.description: Capability status of this projection, independent of the migration status.

dependencies.description: Object ids this projection depends on.

diagnostics.description: Structured diagnostics produced while building the projection.

provenance.description: Where the projection came from (deriving objects, source ranges, generator identity). Schema-required on every embedded projection (oneOf embedded branch); optional on external-only records. Shape may grow with projection implementers.

SidecarRecord.description: A physical sidecar file created only at a hard safety boundary (oversized output, raw/compressed/bulk payload).

path.description: Path relative to the canonical document's directory; never absolute, never escaping via '..'.

sha256.description: Lower- or upper-case hex SHA-256 of the sidecar bytes.

reason.description: Why the sidecar was split out (e.g. size boundary, raw payload that cannot be safely embedded).

source_range.description: Serialized source range in the package the sidecar content was derived from.

ByteAccountingScope.description: Byte accounting for one requested object window: a non-empty tiling of leaf regions with no gaps or overlaps. An empty leaf collection never satisfies completeness.

window.description: The requested serialized window for this object.

leaves.description: Leaf regions that exactly tile the window; never empty for a non-empty window.

ByteLeaf.description: One leaf region of an object's serialized window.

status.description: How the bytes were accounted for.

reason.description: Why the leaf is opaque/payload/unavailable; required in practice for non-decoded leaves.

payload_ref.description: Payload descriptor id when the leaf is extractable.

semantic.description: 'complete' means a decoded-tier handler produced the semantics for this object. Summary-tier output (kind/name echoes, light digests such as Niagara, mesh or depth=asset Blueprint summaries) stays 'partial'.

properties.description: Bounded compact property view (semantic view, depth >= object, #636): name -> scalar descriptor; containers length-elided; raw blobs excluded.

property_count.description: Total names in the bag; fewer may be listed (bounded view). Full bag: raw/debug views.

Relation.description: Directed edge read as 'from relates-to to': from is the object that carries the reference and to is the referent. Kinds have no universal inverse reading — query the reverse direction by filtering on to with the per-kind meaning. Meaning of to relative to from: outer_of = the Outer (containing object) of from; class_of = the class of from; super_of = the superclass of from; template_of = the template/archetype of from; depends_on = an entry of from's dependency list (from depends on to); preload_of = an object that must be preloaded before from. Contract-reserved kinds (not emitted by the current legacy reader) read from the subject side: generated_class_of = from is the generated class of to; default_object_of = from is the default object of to; references = from references to. Example: {"kind": "outer_of", "from": "export:5", "to": "export:2"} reads 'the Outer of export:5 is export:2', i.e. export:5 is contained in export:2.

package_name.description: Import class package path as carried by the model (#632); empty when the import has no class package.

count.description: Aggregation count for repeated identical diagnostics.

reason.description: Optional classification of why this diagnostic was emitted. Omitted when unset. Mirrors models.diagnostics.DiagnosticReason.

fallback.description: Fallback action taken when the diagnostic was recovered. Omitted when unset.

asset_object_ids.description: Objects with the 'asset' role (sorted by table index).
